_meta: The words County Profiles uses about itself outside its slides: the schema.org Dataset text (scripts/county-profiles/structured-data.js), the link descriptions of the choosers and topic decks (scripts/county-profiles/headline.js) and the preview card (scripts/county-profiles/og/cards.js). Edit freely; the {names} in braces are filled in at build. No em dashes.

dataset.countyDescription: {topics} for {county} County, California. Rebuilt from public data in the style of NOAA's Coastal County Snapshots, with the year each figure covers and the source it comes from. A dated snapshot, downloadable as JSON.

topicPhrases.flood: flood hazard exposure (people, critical facilities, flood insurance claims, jobs and natural features in the FEMA 100-year floodplain)
topicPhrases.slr: sea level rise exposure (people, critical facilities, jobs and land in areas exposed to 2 to 10 feet of sea level rise, and when each height may be reached)
topicPhrases.total-economy: total economy exposure (establishments, jobs, wages, GDP, economic diversity and jobs at risk)
topicPhrases.marine-economy: marine economy exposure (establishments, jobs, wages, GDP and the sectors of the ocean economy)

dataset.collectionName: County Profiles: California coastal and Delta counties
dataset.collectionDescription: Flood hazard, sea level rise, and marine and total economy exposure for the {count} California counties in NOAA's Coastal County Snapshots, rebuilt from public data in the style of those snapshots. One dated profile per county, each with the year every figure covers and a JSON download.

headlines._note: One sentence per section that may lead a page's description, in the order tried. The helper takes the first section, in the topic's own order, that is available, has its callout, and whose callout figure is plain (not withheld, partial, a floor or marked estimated), and whose sentence has every {name} it uses. {share} is the callout's own figure; the others are the values the callout or chart prints (section-models.js, `vars`). {caption} is the self-employment callout's own sentence. {county} is the county name. Remove a section's line to stop it being used; a topic with none usable falls back to noFigure.

flood.people-at-risk: {popCount} people ({popShare} of residents) in {county} County live in the FEMA 100-year floodplain.
flood.critical-facilities: {share} of the critical facilities in {county} County are in the FEMA 100-year floodplain.
flood.jobs-at-risk: {share} of the {total} jobs in {county} County are in the FEMA 100-year floodplain.

slr.people-at-risk: {count} people ({share} of residents) in {county} County live in areas exposed to {ft} ft of sea level rise.
slr.critical-facilities: {count} of the {total} critical facilities in {county} County are in areas exposed to {ft} ft of sea level rise.
slr.jobs-at-risk: {count} jobs ({share} of all jobs) in {county} County are in areas exposed to {ft} ft of sea level rise.

total-economy.measuring: {county} County has {jobs} jobs, {share} of all employment in California.
total-economy.diversity: {share} of the workforce in {county} County works in {sector}, its largest sector.

marine-economy.measuring: {jobs} jobs in {county} County are in the marine economy, {share} of total employment.
marine-economy.diversity: {share} of the marine economy workforce in {county} County works in {sector}.

noFigure.topic: {topic} exposure for {county} County, California, with the year each figure covers.

card._note: The preview card (1200 by 630). It carries no figures and no date, so it never goes stale and a dated page shares its current page's card. The layout is scripts/county-profiles/og/cards.js; change CARD_VERSION there when the layout changes, so cached cards are redrawn.
card.label: County Profiles
card.toolLine: Flood, sea level rise and coastal economy exposure, from public data
